# rulecheck modeexits baseline: place (noun chain outside in, ">" joined; "@modal" when in a modal), mode, kind, count, reason (tab separated).
# A row says: MODE can be entered at PLACE (a row on the walk enters or switches to it, the noun pins it, or the noun's own
# table binds rows in it) and no key there leaves it: no row switches to another mode, no row's verb declares that it
# leaves the mode or closes the modal (Operation.Exits), a pending mode has no row that ends it, and no leader key reached
# from the mode leads out. kind "no-exit": nothing on the walk could leave it; kind "exit-not-declared": rows answer there
# whose verbs may change the mode in Go with nothing declared: declare the one that leaves (Operation.Exits), or bind a
# key to a verb that does. Fix it by adding a way out; a row with a reason is a reviewed exception, one without is debt
# that only shrinks (RULECHECK_UPDATE=1).
completion	insert	exit-not-declared	1	the completion list under its older name, walked on its own: it is never focused alone; its rows join the focused input's walk while suggestions are open, where esc completion.dismiss hides them and the input's esc leaves insert (ochazuke's baseline holds the same row for ochazuke.completion)
ochazuke.bindings-help	help_bind_literal	exit-not-declared	1	one-shot: its any row (bindings-help.bind-key, Staying) takes the next key and returns to help_bind_pending, where esc bind-cancel leaves (ochazuke's baseline holds the same row)
ochazuke.completion	insert	exit-not-declared	1	the completion instance is never focused on its own: its rows join the focused input's walk while suggestions are open, where esc completion.dismiss hides them and the input's esc leaves insert (ochazuke's baseline holds the same row)
page>outline>list>pane	visual-line	exit-not-declared	1	stale recorded place (places.json) under pre-ochazuke-prefix names that no noun answers to; the current place ochazuke.page>ochazuke.outline>ochazuke.collection>pane has esc collection.end-visual
pane	visual-line	exit-not-declared	1	the pane noun walked bare (every noun alone): pane rows are only drawn in a collection (Panes tree, index, related sections), whose esc collection.end-visual leaves visual-line; every recorded pane place under ochazuke.collection passes
